name: The Greywater Deep
descriptionSeed: A grey sea off the Palelands, and the selkies who keep it. They come ashore at the Ashwardens' cairns to sing for the drowned, and take their skins back before morning.
encounterFlavor: selkies, Ashwarden cairn-keepers, and mourners who come to hear the singing
axisVectorNote: Derived from authored spectrum against world_node_atlas.axisOrder (SNG-180).
worldPosNote: SNG-670: placed on the world's own sea (Erik 2026-10-04: "they live in pockets across the world, in the typical places of their kind").
appearance: A grey harbour of seal-rocks and kelp, a ring of cairns on the shore, and grey heads in the water watching anyone who comes down to the tide-line.
_sng670: A pocket: a centre with its own ground, the way a foothill is. Its people are not a tradition; its ruling power and leader come in pass 2.
